title: 2권 스토리북 · sb2_map_done
prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, hand-drawn 2D style, thick soft dark-brown outlines, flat bright cheerful colors with a light paper texture and gentle watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes. No photo-realism, no 3D render look. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene with a simple uncluttered background and a calm, simple sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Full-page picture-book illustration. The characters must look exactly like the ones in the attached character sheet (left to right: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble, Beads). Scene: The same hand-drawn map of the Word Pond as before, but now a complete bridge of round stepping stones in many rows crosses the whole pond, a trail of tiny bird footprints runs along it from the fence gap to the far bank, paper lanterns hang over the party lawn, and at the top edge of the pine forest two small pale wisps of light glow with a little path leading into the trees. No letters or text anywhere. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers. Beads is a small friendly caterpillar whose body is a string of five round beads in rainbow colors (red, orange, yellow, green, blue), big round sparkling eyes, two tiny antennae tipped with little beads, a cheerful open smile, no letters on the beads.
